name: codewave-workspace
description: Cruisers Crib Auto Care Center staff web, customer mobile, and service APIs.

scripts.check:policy: node tools/repo-policy-check.mjs && node tools/check-file-growth.mjs && node --test tools/check-file-growth.test.mjs tools/retired-scope-policy.test.mjs tools/worktree-partition.test.mjs tools/worktree-snapshot.test.mjs
scripts.check:web: npm run test:web && npm --workspace autocare-web run build && npm run performance:web
scripts.check:mobile: npm run test:mobile && npm run performance:mobile
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile
scripts.performance:mobile:export: npm --workspace mobile exec -- expo export --platform android --output-dir ../.managed-runtime/mobile-performance-export --clear --source-maps
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run check:policy
scripts.audit: npm run audit:root && npm run audit:backend && npm run audit:web && npm run audit:mobile
scripts.migration:smoke: node --test tools/migration-schema-drift.test.mjs && node -r dotenv/config tools/migration-smoke.mjs dotenv_config_path=backend/.env
scripts.dev:main:foreground: node tools/runtime-watchdog.mjs --name backend-main --port 3000 --cwd . --health-url http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health -- npm run dev:main:raw
scripts.dev:web:foreground: node tools/runtime-watchdog.mjs --name staff-web --port 3002 --cwd . --health-url http://127.0.0.1:3002/bookings -- npm run dev:web:raw
scripts.dev:storybook:foreground: node tools/runtime-watchdog.mjs --name storybook-web --port 6006 --cwd . --health-url http://127.0.0.1:6006 -- npm run dev:storybook:raw
scripts.dev:storybook:mobile:foreground: node tools/runtime-watchdog.mjs --name storybook-mobile --port 8085 --cwd . --health-url http://127.0.0.1:8085/status -- npm run dev:storybook:mobile:raw
scripts.dev:mobile:foreground: node tools/runtime-watchdog.mjs --name mobile-lan --port 8081 --cwd . -- npm run dev:mobile:raw
scripts.dev:mobile:web:foreground: node tools/runtime-watchdog.mjs --name mobile-web --port 8090 --cwd . --health-url http://127.0.0.1:8090 -- npm run dev:mobile:web:raw
scripts.test:runtime: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tools/runtime-manager.test.mjs tools/runtime-definitions.test.mjs tools/runtime-file-utils.test.mjs tools/runtime-retention.test.mjs tools/runtime-probe.test.mjs tools/graphify-check.test.mjs tools/workspace-check-runner.test.mjs backend/scripts/compiled-service-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.agents:check: npm run agents:manifest && npm --workspace backend run agents:check
scripts.check:storybook: npm run test:storybook && npm run build:storybook && npm run qa:storybook
